records.text: In a viewer comment read by Owens, Melissa B (surname unverified) said the never-before-seen Charlie Kirk episodes Erika Kirk and her associates had touted had not appeared.

appearances.snippet: Uh, Melissa B (viewer; surname unverified) writes, it's so interesting that we haven't seen any of the never-before-seen Charlie (Charlie Kirk) episodes that Erika (Erika Kirk) and her henchmen were bragging about.
